title: Grounding the controllers after reinforcement learning, beyond the sender's own window
description: Grounding (step 3) on the controllers of experiments/controller-rl.json, read from its release: for each teacher (Cubic, BBRv3), the discovery controllers after 120 iterations of PPO at widths 7, 10 and 16, seeds 1 to 3. The width of the latents is not read as a count of concepts (docs/methodology.md, what the width cannot count). Each cell runs one controller's exported policy in the closed loop, without exploration noise and with every step kept: on 96 (link, condition) pairs sampled from the training links (the same pairs and seeds for every controller), where the fits are made, and on all 21 validation links under 6 conditions, where they are scored. Collect then runs, once per teacher, experiments/ground.py probe (per controller on its own rollouts: the decision regressed on the latents, each library variable read from the latents and each latent written from the variables, and the agreement between seeds of one width) and select. This is the first run of select since it holds the sender's own window in every fit: a path lists what a feature adds to the window's own features, the decision is grounded as the change it makes to the window, and the formula search scores a formula after the window is taken out. The earlier grounding (exp-ground-rl-27, exp-ground-teachers-26) picked the window and the flow's packets in flight first. The library is every stored label in both windows, the twelve composites and four sender measurements, under eight operators. What is read: how much of the latents and of the decision's change the window alone explains, which features of the path are added first and how much they add, whether seeds and teachers agree on them, and how a small network on the picked features compares with one on the whole library. These controllers come from one untuned point of the reinforcement-learning settings, none reaches the fixed rule and two of the Cubic controllers at width 7 diverged, so this run supports no claim about concepts. It checks the method. The test links are not read.
run: R="ctl-$TEACHER-k$K-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$OUT/$R"; cp "$IN/runs/$R"/{ppo_spec.json,net1.pt,actor.pt,policy.onnx} "$OUT/$R/"; uv run python experiments/ground.py rollouts "$OUT/$R" --fit "$IN/runs/setup/paths/campaign.json" --score "$IN/runs/setup/eval/campaign.json" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
collect: for T in cubic bbr3; do uv run python experiments/ground.py probe "$OUT/probe-$T" --runs "$OUT"/ctl-$T-k*; uv run python experiments/ground.py select "$OUT/select-$T" --runs "$OUT"/ctl-$T-k*; done
